svg.title: Financial AI Co-Pilot — Full Architecture Overview
svg.desc: Five-phase architecture diagram showing file ingestion through to the conversational chatbot, with quantitative and qualitative pipelines feeding a tool layer and LLM orchestrator.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What file types does the system accept?')
sendPrompt('What happens in the file detection and pre-normalization stage?')
sendPrompt('How does the schema mapping LLM call work?')
sendPrompt('What do the Phase 1 validators check?')
sendPrompt('What is the qualitative context pipeline in Phase 2?')
sendPrompt('What Python tools are in the Phase 3 tool layer?')
sendPrompt('What is the onboarding conversation gate?')
sendPrompt('How does the Phase 4 LLM orchestrator work?')
g.text: Entity resolution · tool routing · conflict-aware response · no free-form SQL

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the Phase 5 Streamlit chat UI render?')
g.text: Answer + citation expander + "show your work" · state machine enforced

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the user see in the final answer?')
g.text: Value · unit · source cell · conversion applied
